title: metadata cache: measure list-then-item DB reads on a hydrating kernel after #34494 (S5)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pmEYLVFDcQ1Z1CS8H

## What

Measure list-then-item metadata reads on a **hydrating kernel** after PR #34494 (the compiled-metadata cache for #34206). Compare the database read count with `main` before #34494.

## Why

review#2's contract review of #34494 (record 6933814641) raised should-fix S5. Each list read moves `registry.revision`, and the new bucket retires the overlay row cache. So a list read followed by item reads may cost more database reads than `main` did. No reading has been taken yet.

## Acceptance

- One reading on a hydrating kernel (seeded store, list then N item reads), before and after #34494.
- If after is no worse than before, close this card with the reading as the reason.
- If after is worse, fix it so the row cache survives a list-driven revision move that changes no rows, and pin the read count.

Carrier of #34494's S5 (state comment 6933826761). Grade it at triage. This card is not claimed by seat repo:objectstack#1, which is winding down.
